claims.sentence: Heritability estimates in twin studies consistently support a genetic basis in anorexia nervosa, with the range of 48-74% ( Holland et al., 1984 ; Klump et al., 2001 ; Kortegaard et al., 2001 ) Recently, the Anorexia Nervosa Genetics Initiative was launched to increase sample sizes for pinpointing genetic risk factors ( Yilmaz et al., 2020 ).
